lines.say: Chapter three. The pitch.

Investors testified they were led to believe Theranos ran its tests on its own machines. The S.E.C. alleged that in its clinical lab, the proprietary analyzer ran only about twelve of the more than two hundred tests on the menu. The rest ran on commercially available analyzers made by other companies, some modified for fingerstick samples.
lines.show: Investors testified they were led to believe Theranos ran its tests on its own machines. The SEC alleged that in its clinical lab, the proprietary analyzer ran only about 12 of the more than 200 tests on the menu. The rest ran on commercially available analyzers made by other companies, some modified for fingerstick samples.
